angle: company and product side: OEM 10-K property lists and plant pages (Caterpillar, Deere, Terex, Astec, CNH, Komatsu, Volvo, Liebherr, Bobcat, JCB, Epiroc, Sandvik, Metso, FLSmidth, Weir and others), attachment/bucket and off-road truck-body makers, AEM / CONEXPO / MINExpo exhibitor angles, trade press
notes: 81 WebSearch queries run (numbered log; two further attempts were refused because the shared web-search budget ran out). searches_until_dry is NOT a true dry point: search 81 (Takeuchi US plant) still produced a new in-definition plant, and the run stopped on the search budget, not on dryness. No class reached a dry point. Even the core OEM class was still yielding: searches 72 (Komatsu Duffield, Lebanon, Homer City), 74 (Kubota Salina) and 81 (Takeuchi Moore) each found new OEM plants; only searches 69, 70, 77 and 80 added nothing. The open-ended tail of small attachment shops, Tier-1 weldment fabricators and underground-mining job shops was NOT exhausted; expect real plants in those classes that are missing here. Sources: 10-K property sections from EDGAR (Caterpillar FY2025, Deere FY2025, Terex FY2025, Astec FY2025, CNH FY2025) plus OEM newsrooms, Astec brand contact table, Epiroc careers search (welder postings Nov 2026), trade press (CEG, KHL, Mining.com, Coal Age, Mining Connection, Power Progress), AEM Manufacturing Express pages. Quotes were copied from page text printed by tools/fetch_page.py (full text saved) and quote_verified uses the same norm() containment as --check. One row has a blank quote and quote_verified=false because the page was blocked (Bobcat Litchfield; bobcat.com serves a captcha). For several 10-K-based rows the quote is the 10-K table text (state: city list), which shows the site and segment but not the product. No product search was run for Caterpillar Decatur, East Peoria, North Little Rock, Athens, Victoria, Sanford and South Milwaukee, Deere Davenport, Dubuque and Kernersville, or CNH Burlington, Fargo and Wichita: their product lines are from prior knowledge plus the 10-K segment and are unverified. 10-K-only rows show status as of December 2025 (Jan-Feb 2026 filing dates); the Wamego case shows a 10-K can still list a plant already announced to close. City not stated on the quoted page (taken from discovery search): J.H. Fletcher (Huntington WV), Fairchild International (Glen Lyn VA), Niece Equipment (Lampasas TX), CMI Roadbuilding (Cedar Rapids IA). Boundary classes (decided once; compute miss rate with and without): (a) asphalt/concrete plant equipment, counted IN: Astec asphalt plants Chattanooga, Heatec, Astec Dillman, CON-E-CO, RexCon, CWMF, CMI Roadbuilding; (b) paving/road machines, IN: Caterpillar Brooklyn Park, Terex Bid-Well Canton, Roadtec/Carlson, LeeBoy, GOMACO, Weiler; (c) aggregate/bulk-material processing (crushers, screens, conveyors, feeders, vibratory), IN: Terex Durand, Terex Mount Vernon, Astec Mobile Screens, JCI, KPI, Gundlach Belleville, Jeffrey Rader Duncan, Superior Morris/Columbus/Prescott Valley/Loganville/Pekin, McLanahan, Eagle Crusher, Lippmann-Milwaukee, Screen Machine, Deister, General Kinematics, Metso Columbia; (d) drill rigs, IN: Caterpillar Denison, Epiroc Garland, Watson (geotechnical/water-well rig makers were not added); (e) utility trenchers/HDD, IN: Ditch Witch Perry, Vermeer Pella; (f) compact equipment, IN: Caterpillar Sanford and Athens, Bobcat Gwinner/Bismarck/Statesville, JCB Savannah, CNH Wichita, Kubota Jefferson and Salina, Yanmar Grand Rapids, Manitou Madison, Wacker Neuson, Takeuchi Moore; telehandler plants: Manitou Yankton counted IN because it also builds articulated loaders, while JCB San Antonio (telehandlers and aerials only) is OUT as lifting - treat Manitou Yankton as boundary; (g) compact/skid-steer attachments, IN: Blue Diamond, Skid Pro, Virnig Rice and Pikeville, Amarekan, Paladin Dexter/Delhi/Ooltewah, Bobcat Litchfield, East Attachments, Amulet; (h) Tier-1/contract fabricators, IN: Broadwind Manitowoc, Weldall, Hol-Mac, Morton Industries, L&H Industrial; (i) underground mining vehicles/locomotives, IN: Brookville, Getman, Phillips Machine; (j) off-road water/fuel tank bodies, IN: HEC, Niece; (k) hydraulic components, OUT: Bobcat Wahpeton; (l) cast ground-engaging tools (foundry), OUT: Weir ESCO Newton, Hensley Dallas; (m) wood/recycling processing, OUT: Terex Newton NH, Peterson Pacific; (n) separation equipment, OUT: Elgin Stafford, Astec Princeton WV, Astec Raleigh IL. Closed/assembly-only rows kept as out: Caterpillar Wamego (closure announced mid-2025, but FY2025 10-K still lists Wamego under Power & Energy), Caterpillar Sumter hydraulics, Caterpillar Houston PA (2016 divestiture review, absent from 10-K), Komatsu Bluefield, Telsmith Mequon, Metso York, Bobcat Rogers (assembly), HD Hyundai/DEVELON Brunswick (customization), JCB San Antonio (telehandlers; lifting). Not placed (lead without a confirmed US plant city): CAI Industries (plants in WV and IL, cities not found), Interstate Mining Products (Beaver WV; search refused by budget), Komatsu Franklin PA (only an engineering posting), Sandvik (Elko NV service workshop; WV rock-bolt JV), Propower tanks, NPK own plant scope, Crenlo cabs, Pengo Laurens IA, Weir ESCO Portland (main plant closed 2016), Stamler, Longwall Associates, DSI Underground, Morton Metalcraft, Miller Welding/BTD, MEC (Mayville Engineering) plants, Wirtgen America Antioch (no manufacturing confirmed), Sakai America (Georgia compactor plant named in a headline; city not confirmed - compactors are an IN class), Schramm (blasthole/water-well rigs; site blocked), Allen Engineering (Paragould AR, concrete equipment; AEM tour stop), TAG Manufacturing (Chickasha OK attachments; site 502), Solesbee's (attachments), Midland Machinery (Tonawanda NY, AEM tour stop), Bradken (US foundries; mining buckets), Swanson Industries / Morgantown Machine (WV mining rebuild/new equipment), Peninsula Iron Works (TerraSource brand; not matched to the Astec Portland OR site). Astec Portland OR, Princeton WV and Raleigh IL rows are out only because the product is unconfirmed; if any is a TerraSource heavy fabricator it belongs in. Failed sources: caterpillar.com and web.archive.org (502 via proxy), equipmentworld.com, forconstructionpros.com, ironpros.com, oemoffhighway.com, compactequip.com, manufacturing-today.com, mining-technology.com, recyclinginside.com (403), epiroc.com and atlascopco.com (403), bobcat.com (captcha), businesswire.com (502), several small company sites (lnhindustrial.com, fairchildinternational.com, caiindustries.com, hensleyattachments.com, virnig.com, tagmfg.com, alliedcp.com). MINExpo/CONEXPO exhibitor lists were not usable (only paywalled data-vendor copies surfaced); AEM member directory not attempted beyond the Manufacturing Express tour pages. Independence: no ledger file about this vertical was opened; all fetched pages were kept in this auditor's own scratch folder (mA/).
